lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Tell, just try to go through in your mind exactly what he told you about him cutting himself. Put it in your own words.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Is everything you're telling me today, Brendan, the truth? Yes or no.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: I have to ask you another difficult question. It's very important, that you to be honest with me. OK? Did you have anything to do with the death of Teresa Halbach?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And Steven did it by how again, tell me that again.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Had he told you that? Yes or no?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he say he had had a gun with a ......... at all?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you ask him about a gun?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And he told you that he did this in her truck?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And he tied her up first?
